issues.issue: Was the RAD's reliance on the DSSH Model reasonable in finding bisexuality not credible?
issues.result_text: DSSH Model misapplied and unexplained; absence of its elements cannot weigh against credibility; unreasonable.

issues.issue: Did the RAD reasonably infer non-credibility from Muslim men's typical reactions and from having one same-sex relationship?
issues.result_text: Reasoning rests on stereotypes and unsupported premises about bisexual persons; internally irrational; unreasonable.
